summary: OpenAI announced a ChatGPT feature allowing healthcare organizations to connect electronic health records and other industry data sources so clinicians can access patient context and medical research within ChatGPT.

categories.reason: The feature lets clinicians pull patient records and clinical context directly into ChatGPT, crossing into care workflows.
categories.quote: ChatGPT can now connect to trusted healthcare data, helping clinicians securely access patient context, medical research, and more.

practices.reason: Connecting EHR and healthcare data sources to ChatGPT introduces new data-source integration and compliance surfaces for any team building on it in a clinical context.
practices.quote: Healthcare organizations can now connect EHR and additional industry data to ChatGPT.
